cause_quote: #193548 deleted the plaintext cache writer together with `sweepMaterializedArchiveCache(cacheDir)` and its age-based `fs.rmSync(entry.path, { force: true })` loop, leaving existing session-archive-read-cache files with no remaining code to remove them.
user_saw: After upgrading, old plaintext session archive cache files stayed in the OpenClaw temp directory indefinitely, consuming disk space.
summary: Adds a Doctor legacy-state check that reports leftover session archive read-cache bytes read-only on lint and removes recognized cache files (and the empty directory) on repair, including the update path.
reasoning: Before #193548 the age-based sweep bounded and expired the plaintext archive cache; #193548 (an hour before this fix) removed the writer and the sweep without a migration, so caches already on disk were never reclaimed, which is exactly what the fix's PR states. I read the #193548 diff of archive-compression.ts and confirmed the removed sweep lines; the fix adds the missing one-time Doctor cleanup.
